messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the RFC review: proposing a minimal PrewarmEscrow handshake so operator stays dumb about budgets. idea is token-based admission + short-lived local bind.
aj: sounds promising. can you outline the token fields and operator responsibilities?
maya: token = opaque signed string. contains budget_id, max_units, est_units, expiry, cache_tier(optional), kid. operator verifies signature, binds token -> reservation_id, enforces max_units.
sam: binding semantics? how do we avoid double-alloc if control-plane retries?
maya: operator must atomically persist binding (in-memory + write-behind or etcd) before admitting. token becomes single-use after bind. control-plane will query reservation status when it retries.
irina: telemetry: operator should emit events with budget_id and reservation_id so billing and optimize can join. add metric prewarm.reservations{budget_id,..}.
leo: metric shape ok. also recommend canonical consumption unit = gpu_milli_minutes. operator reports consumed_gpu_milli_minutes; control-plane maps to units via budget config.
aj: how to charge batching/cache amortization? operator should report raw gpu_milli_minutes and a flag for batch_amortized. control-plane applies amortization factor in ledger.
maya: control-plane APIs: POST /prewarm-intent -> returns {escrow_token, est_units, expiry}. operator: POST /reserve -> {escrow_token, node_selector?} -> returns reservation_id or 403. then POST /consume -> {reservation_id, consumed_gpu_milli_minutes} periodically and DELETE /release. GET /reservation/{id}/status for reconciliation.
sam: what about revoke flow? if budget is depleted, control-plane should try graceful-trim first. operator reduces new admissions for that token; control-plane can call POST /revoke to force stop.
aj: what SLO for revoke effect? 30s to stop new admits seems reasonable. operator should stop admitting for revoked tokens immediately once noticed.
irina: acceptance criteria for rollout: (1) operator rejects invalid tokens; (2) consumption metrics emitted within 1m of occurrence; (3) control-plane can revoke and prevent new reserves within 30s.
leo: operator local-store risk: prefer leader-lease in memory for speed, reconcile on restart with GET /reservations. if operator persists to etcd, ensure bind <50ms.
maya: security: tokens signed by control-plane key; include kid header for rotation. token expiry short (minutes) and renew via prewarm-intent.
ops-bot: ops note: add alert prewarm.bind.rate and prewarm.revoke.rate if either spikes 3x baseline for >5m.
sam: rollout plan: feature flag. stage 1 = token + reserve/consume/release; stage 2 = revoke/graceful-trim + cache_tier; stage 3 = amortization tuning, batching heuristics.
irina: testing: simulate 200 concurrent small prewarms, mixed durations, ensure control-plane ledger matches operator reports within 5% after amortization.
leo: one more: operator may implement local heuristics (fairness, soft caps) but must never exceed token.max_units. billing authoritative in control-plane.
aj: action items: maya -> spec + proto examples; leo -> operator bind prototype; nirina -> telemetry schema; sam -> rollout checklist.
maya: I'll draft addendum today and ping infra for a test etcd cluster. thanks :thumbsup:
